recommended_approach: Use a Mantaflow LIQUID domain with FLIP-style liquid behavior, a continuous inflow emitter for the pour, and a collision glass obstacle; then prioritize simulation stability/detail via Substeps Per Frame and liquid mesh quality controls (Mesh Generator=Final, careful smoothing/concavity), and bake cache before rendering in Cycles.

mesh_notes.smoothing_positive: keep moderate (too high can remove small droplets)
mesh_notes.smoothing_negative: increase moderately to preserve splash detail

shading_notes.liquid: Principled BSDF transmission/liquid look with warm lighting
shading_notes.subsurface: Principled Subsurface methods documented (Christensen-Burley / Random Walk) for translucent appearance control

alternative_approaches: If liquid detail is too noisy/heavy, use Preview mesh generator during look-dev and switch to Final for final bake.

Use glass/material optimization patterns (Principled transmission + smoother glass mesh) to improve realism even when sim settings are fixed.
